item.title: STRONG WIND WARNING FOR NIUE LAND AREAS AND COASTAL WATERS
item.description: Strong winds are expected across Niue and surrounding coastal waters. Strong gusts may damage loose objects, tree branches and weak structures. Rough and hazardous sea conditions are also expected.

item.title: Drought: YELLOW ALERT REMAINS IN FORCE FOR NIUE
item.description: Dry and windy conditions continue across Niue. Below-normal rainfall is forecast for the next three months, while strong winds may further increase the risk of bushfires.
